subject: Q4 budget update
body: Q4 budget is approved at $120k. Please allocate $40k to marketing experiments and keep $20k as buffer.

subject: Product launch planning
body: We should align launch messaging around reliability and speed. Proposed launch date is Dec 10. Final copy needed by Nov 25.

subject: Hiring freeze clarification
body: There will be no new headcount approvals in Q4. Please plan assuming current team size.

subject: Infra stability concerns
body: We saw multiple production alerts last week. Infra reliability should be prioritized over feature work.

subject: Marketing spend follow-up
body: Reminder that marketing experiments should stay within the $40k allocation approved earlier.

subject: Launch dependencies
body: The Dec 10 launch depends on infra signoff and final QA results by Dec 3.

subject: Budget risk note
body: If infra issues continue, we may need to reallocate part of the marketing budget toward reliability work.

subject: End-of-quarter checklist
body: Please complete infra audits, budget reconciliation, and launch readiness review before Dec 20.
